newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dain starts Nike with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dain starts Nike with buy.

text.p: Dain Bosworth said it began coverage of Nike Inc with a buy rating based on the company's brand strength and long-term earnings power.
Dain Bosworth's 12 to 18 month price target for Nike is $69-$70 a share based on 20 times its fiscal 1999 earnings estimate.

Earnings for Nike's fiscal year to end May 31, 1998 is estimated at $2.95 a share on estimated revenues of $10.74 billion, Dain Bosworth said in a report. The athletic footwear and apparel manufacturer reported fiscal 1997 earnings of $2.68 a share on sales of $9.19 billion.
Shares of Nike were trading at 57-1/2, unchanged from Tuesday's close.
